units.source_text: 源氏公子对紫姬说：“前年藤壶母后曾在庭院中造一个雪山。

en.t: Prince Genji said to Lady Murasaki, "The year before last, Empress Fujitsubo made a snow mountain in the garden.

units.source_text: 这原是世间寻常游戏，但出于母后之意，便成了风流韵事。

en.t: It was originally an ordinary game in the world, but because it came from Her Majesty's own idea, it became an elegant and romantic affair.

units.source_text: 我每逢四时佳兴，想起了母后夭逝，便觉得遗恨无穷，不胜悼惜。

en.t: Whenever the beauty of the four seasons stirs my delight, I remember Her Majesty's early death and feel endless regret and unbearable sorrow.

units.source_text: 母后总是异常疏远我，因此，我不能接近她，详悉细情。

en.t: Her Majesty always kept me strangely at a distance, so I could not draw near to her or learn the details of her thoughts.

units.source_text: 然每次在宫中谒见，母后总视我为可以信赖之人。

en.t: Yet whenever I had an audience with her at court, she always treated me as someone she could trust.

units.source_text: 我也多多仰仗于她，凡事必向她请教。

en.t: I too relied on her greatly and would consult her about everything.

units.source_text: 她对人虽不能言善辩，然而言必有中。

en.t: Although she was not eloquent in speaking with people, everything she said struck the mark.

units.source_text: 即使寻常细事，亦必安排妥帖。

en.t: Even ordinary small matters she always arranged with perfect care.

units.source_text: 如此英明之人，世间岂能再得！

en.t: How could the world ever find another person so wise and discerning!

units.source_text: 她秉性温柔沉着，

en.t: Her nature was gentle and composed,

units.source_text: 其敦厚周谨与风韵娴雅之处，

en.t: and in her kindness, careful propriety, graceful charm, and refined elegance,

units.source_text: 无人可与并比。

en.t: no one could stand beside her as an equal.

units.source_text: 只有你和她血缘最近，颇有几分相似。

en.t: Only you are closest to her by blood, and you resemble her in several ways.

units.source_text: 然而有点嫉妒的样子，略有些儿固执，做人太不圆通，真乃美中不足了。

en.t: But you show a little jealousy, are somewhat stubborn, and are too inflexible with people; that truly is the flaw in your beauty.

units.source_text: 前斋院槿姬呢，又另是一种人物。

en.t: As for Princess Asagao, the former Kamo priestess, she is another kind of person altogether.

units.source_text: 彼此寂寞无聊之时，便互通音信，谈些无关紧要的话。

en.t: When we are lonely and bored, we exchange letters and talk about unimportant things.

units.source_text: 但我也得随时留心，不敢略有放肆。

en.t: Even so, I must always be careful and do not dare behave with the slightest impropriety.

units.source_text: 如此高雅之人，现今世上恐只剩她一人了。”

en.t: A woman of such refinement may now be the only one left in the world."

units.source_text: 紫姬说：“那末我倒要问你：

en.t: Lady Murasaki said, "Then let me ask you this:

units.source_text: 那位尚侍胧月夜，做事周到，人品也很高雅，绝不像一个轻佻之人，

en.t: that Naishi no Kami, Oborozukiyo, is thorough in all she does, and her character is very refined; she certainly does not seem frivolous,

units.source_text: 怎么和你之间也有了风言风语的传闻？

en.t: so how did rumors and gossip arise about her and you?

units.source_text: 我真想不通了。”

en.t: I truly cannot understand it."

units.source_text: 源氏公子答道：“你说得是。

en.t: Prince Genji replied, "You are right.

units.source_text: 讲到容颜美丽，她是数一数二的人。

en.t: When it comes to beauty of appearance, she is among the very finest.

units.source_text: 至于那件事，我对她不起，想起了后悔莫及。

en.t: As for that matter, I wronged her, and when I think of it, my regret is beyond repair.

units.source_text: 大凡风流之人，年纪越大起来，懊悔之事越多。

en.t: In general, people of romantic feeling have more and more things to regret as they grow older.

units.source_text: 我自问比别人稳重得多，尚且如此。”

en.t: I consider myself far more prudent than others, and yet even I am like this."

units.source_text: 说起胧月夜，源氏公子掉了几点眼泪。

en.t: As he spoke of Oborozukiyo, Prince Genji shed a few tears.

units.source_text: 接着又谈到明石姬，源氏公子说：“这个乡下人，微不足数，被人看轻。

en.t: Then the conversation turned to the Lady of Akashi, and Prince Genji said, "This country woman is considered insignificant and is looked down upon.

units.source_text: 不过出身虽然低微，却懂得道理。

en.t: Yet although her birth is humble, she understands what is proper.

units.source_text: 只是由于出身不如别人，反而气度过分高傲，也终是美中不足。

en.t: Only because her background is inferior to others, she has instead become excessively proud, and that too is a flaw in her beauty.

units.source_text: 我还没有会过身份十分低微的人。

en.t: I have not yet associated with anyone of truly very low rank.

units.source_text: 然而十分优越的女子，在这世间也真难得。

en.t: Still, a woman of outstanding excellence is truly hard to find in this world.

units.source_text: 东院里那个孤居独处的人，心情始终不变，真可赞佩。

en.t: The woman living alone in the East Residence has kept her heart unchanged from beginning to end, which is truly admirable.

units.source_text: 这也是很难做到的事。

en.t: That too is a very difficult thing to do.

units.source_text: 我当初赏识她那谦虚恭谨的美德，因而与她结识。

en.t: At first I admired her virtues of modesty and reverence, and so I came to know her.

units.source_text: 自此以后，她一直是那样谦虚恭谨地安度岁月呢。

en.t: Since then, she has passed the years in just that modest and respectful way.

units.source_text: 到了现在，我越发赏识她的厚道，从此不会抛弃她。”

en.t: Now I value her warm-heartedness all the more, and from now on I will not abandon her."

units.source_text: 两人共话过去现在种种事情，直到夜深。

en.t: The two of them talked together about all sorts of matters past and present until late into the night.
